propositions: Attribute-form git wrapper calls (e.g., core._git, self._git, mod.run_git) are already correctly detected by the ast.Attribute branch in _wrapper_name, but this capability is undocumented and untested, leaving it vulnerable to accidental removal in future refactors.
All eight existing R2 tests in test_raw_git_write_lint.py exercise only the bare ast.Name form, creating a false appearance that attribute-form detection is absent or unvalidated.

The _ref_lock_push.py file has no gate hits not because attribute detection fails, but because its push_lease_cas call passes 'push', which is correctly excluded from MUTATION_VERBS, and adding a marker would be incorrect noise.

The module docstring of check_raw_git_writes.py must be updated to explicitly state that wrapper matching is by the callable's attribute name regardless of receiver shape, not just 'BY NAME', to document the already-working attribute-form behavior.
